title: How Haldiram scaled operations and delighted more customers with On2Cook.
cardExcerpt: How a fast-growing cafe chain improved order consistency, reduced manual effort, and enhanced customer experience with on2cook.
snapshot_description: Haldiram is one of India's most beloved food brands, known for its wide range of sweets, snacks, and savory delights. With a legacy dating back to 1937, Haldiram has built a strong presence across the country, serving millions of customers with taste and trust.
challenge_title: Inconsistent Quality, High Manual Effort & Longer Preparation Time
challenge_description: With a wide variety of menu items and high footfall across outlets, Haldiram's faced challenges in maintaining consistent taste and quality. Manual cooking processes led to longer preparation times, higher dependency on skilled staff, and operational inefficiencies.
challenge_points: Inconsistent taste and quality across outlets|High manual effort and dependency on skilled staff|Longer cooking times affecting order turnaround|Higher food wastage and operational costs
solution_description: Haldiram's partnered with on2cook to bring automation and precision to their kitchens. With standardized recipes, intelligent cooking, and consistent execution, on2cook helped streamline operations across all outlets.
solution_points: Standardized recipes & automated cooking|Reduced dependency on skilled staff|Faster cooking with consistent quality|Better control on costs & wastage
results_description: On2cook delivered tangible outcomes that strengthened operations and customer experience.
results_points: Consistent taste and quality across all outlets|Faster service and reduced wait times|Lower operational costs and food waste|Happier customers and higher retention

title: How a high-volume kitchen in Jaipur cut LPG costs, simplified operations, and kept consistent quality with on2cook.
cardExcerpt: How a high-volume kitchen in Jaipur cut LPG costs, simplified operations, and kept consistent quality with on2cook.
snapshot_description: Chef N Dish (Kabulee Kitchen) runs a high-volume cloud kitchen out of Jaipur, serving North Indian gravies, Chinese, and desserts. Handling 200-250 orders a day, the kitchen needed a way to keep up without rising costs or inconsistent results.
challenge_title: High LPG Dependency Slowing Down a Growing Kitchen
challenge_description: Keeping up with daily demand meant relying on 5-6 LPG cylinders every month. As the kitchen got busier, costs kept climbing — and so did the pressure on cooks to keep every dish consistent.
challenge_points: High monthly cost from 5-6 LPG cylinders|Taste consistency dependent on skilled cooks|Food wastage adding to daily costs|More kitchen staff needed to manage volume
solution_description: Chef N Dish brought in 3 On2Cook units to replace LPG-based cooking. With standardized, induction-powered cooking, the kitchen could run leaner without compromising on taste.
solution_points: Replaced LPG cylinders with induction-based cooking|Ran the entire kitchen with just 2 cooks|Cooked exact quantities needed, cutting waste|Delivered consistent taste across every batch
results_description: With on2cook, Chef N Dish now runs a leaner kitchen with higher profit margins, lower dependency on skilled chefs, and the same consistent taste in every order. It's also freed up kitchen staff to handle other tasks while the cooking runs on its own.
